name: hud_ui_mgr_tick_layout_delay
description: HudUiMgr::TickLayoutDelay decrements the pending HUD layout delay when active and reports whether a delay tick was consumed.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiMgr layout/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x410140 validates a leaf cdecl helper that reads g_HudUiMgrLayoutDelayFrames, returns 0 when it is zero, otherwise decrements the global and returns 1.
The native HUD layout smoke stages an active delay count, verifies TickLayoutDelay returns 1 and decrements it, then stages a zero delay and verifies TickLayoutDelay returns 0.
